definitions.global_nonpositive_margin: Logged legal training relations where detached global cosine positive-minus-negative margin is <=0.
definitions.correction_ratio: Mean per training batch of norm(raw_features-shared_global)/norm(shared_global); report unweighted mean of recorded batch means within an epoch.
definitions.counts: Repeated training triplet/query exposures; not unique identities, independent trials or query/gallery retrieval samples.

scope: Descriptive saved source-training logs of four completed seed42 endpoints/two datasets only. Not same-checkpoint query/gallery geometry, regional standalone retrieval, exact global-margin distribution, training ambiguity weights, a cause of failure, or a justification for gain/seed rescue. No model/tensor/optimizer/SSH/GPU/production invocation. Official benchmark was consumed in development.
